leads.name: Drago de Igueste de Candelaria
leads.reason: Confirmed to exist and to carry municipal protection status (listed on tenerife.es's own arboles-monumentales portal and mentioned by candelaria.es for the Igueste district), but no age, height or girth figure found this pass, and no second independent source beyond the Cabildo listing. candelaria.es itself failed to fetch (self-signed certificate error). Worth a second pass with a direct visit to candelaria.es via browser or a search of local Tenerife press. UPDATE 2026-11-02: tenerife.es ficha page timed out twice this pass; retry https://www.tenerife.es/w/drago-de-igueste-de-candelaria (the /w/<slug> pages are fetchable with a normal browser User-Agent and carry a Google Maps short link whose 7-decimal coordinate is tree-level).

leads.name: El Almacigo (Pistacia atlantica singular specimen), El Sauzal
leads.reason: tenerife.es's own arboles-monumentales portal names 'El Almacigo, El Sauzal' as a designated monumental tree, but no page giving its specific age, height or exact address was found this pass; general species background (can exceed 1000 years) was found but not tied to this specimen. A different, better documented Almacigo exists in Arona (9m tall) per a general search, not the same tree. UPDATE 2026-11-02: ficha https://www.tenerife.es/w/el-almacigo: El Sauzal, urbanizacion Los Perales, PRIVATE land, 6 m tall, 120 cm perimeter, municipal protection, in an abandoned farm plot on the Barranco de Los Perales edge: private and small, do not ship.

leads.name: Sabina de la finca 'La Sabina', Buenavista del Norte
leads.reason: Named on tenerife.es's monumental-tree portal but not researched further this pass; no age/dimensions/coordinates found yet. leads.name: Pino Canario 'Pino del Senor', Arafo
leads.reason: Named on tenerife.es's monumental-tree portal but not researched further this pass; no age/dimensions/coordinates found yet. UPDATE 2026-11-02: verified as tfe_008 in data/research/tenerife-verified.json.

leads.name: Pino Derrengado, Arico
leads.reason: Named on tenerife.es's monumental-tree portal but not researched further this pass; no age/dimensions/coordinates found yet. Note the same portal also separately lists a 'Pinos de Tea del Horno del Buey' cluster in Arico, which reads as a stand/ensemble rather than one collectible point, so it was not pursued as a candidate. UPDATE 2026-11-02: Cabildo ficha https://www.tenerife.es/w/pino-derrengado gives public land, insular protection, 500 m, height 4 m, perimeter 640 cm, on Carretera General del Sur km 59.100 opposite the Las Casitas junction (Luis Delgado area), crown flagged by wind to the SW; Tenerife Weekly 2021 says it sits in the El Bueno hamlet, hemmed in by power lines, and was a 2022 Spanish Tree of the Year candidate. No usable coordinate (the Cabildo Maps link is rounded to 28.2,-16.53), no OSM node, no Commons file, no recent photo: no photo or exact pin in reach.

leads.name: Palmeral de El Sauzal
leads.reason: Named on tenerife.es's monumental-tree portal but reads as a grove/ensemble rather than one collectible point with one obvious place to stand; would need a specific named individual palm within it to qualify, not pursued this pass.

leads.name: Drago de San Miguel de Geneto (La Laguna)
leads.reason: Cabildo ficha https://www.tenerife.es/w/drago-de-san-miguel-de-geneto: municipal protection, public land, 10 m, 600 cm perimeter, beside the San Miguel de Geneto road opposite the Santa Rosa de Lima school, in the yard of an old hacienda beside the Germobanco Agricola de la Macaronesia, visible from the road. Cabildo Maps link 28.4777131,-16.3183947. Single source, lifecheck NONE, and unclear whether the yard is open (visible from road only): no alive check, access doubtful.

leads.name: El Patriarca (Canary cedar, Juniperus cedrus), Las Canadas side
leads.reason: OSM natural=tree node only (28.2690195,-16.5868306, natural_monument); no Cabildo ficha under the guessed slug and no second source found this pass. Worth a pass: likely in Teide National Park / Corona Forestal and would be a fine single-tree walk if sourced.

leads.name: Drago de la Plaza de la Junta Suprema and Drago del Adelantado (La Laguna)
leads.reason: OSM nodes only (28.4909497,-16.3190064 with a Commons photo; 28.4876285,-16.3134853). No catalogue ficha or age found. Diario de Avisos Aug 2026 reports the two dragos in front of the Cathedral are only about 60 years old and one fell on 15 Aug 2026, and a historic drago on private land at the La Laguna entrance (calle Marzuca) was felled in Nov 2025, so La Laguna dragos need a fresh life check; the Seminario and calle del Agua dragos named by Spanish Wikipedia were not found in any source with data.
